token-router v0.1.0 changelog

- Initial release of the token-router skill.
- Provides smart LLM model routing and token cost optimization.
- Supports complexity evaluation and tiered model recommendations to balance cost and quality.
- Includes safety upgrade rules for high-stakes tasks.
- Offers guidance for configuring multi-model routing on platforms like Trae, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
- Specially triggers for user queries related to cost saving, model selection, API/token usage, and workflow optimization.
